comments.author: xyst
comments.story: Supreme Court allows multibillion-dollar class action to proceed against Meta
comments.text: FB will settle out of court. Probably a third of what shareholders are asking. Lawyers get paid handsomely on both sides. Parent company has washed away the stink of Cambridge Analytica fallout (remember those bs “sorry” videos and newspaper ads? [1,2]). Shareholders get a pittance. I’m a bit over this hyper-capitalistic market. When are C-level executives going to pay for their actions? Where is the jail time for these people? This country is a joke. [1] [VIDEO] [2] [LINK]

comments.author: aaron-lebo
comments.story: Facebook management moves around but people don’t leave
comments.text: It's only powerful if you actually change. Otherwise you're just using one of the classic tricks of manipulators. "I'm sorry, it won't happen this time" is what abusive relationships are made of. [VIDEO] Do people find this sincere? It seems fake/manipulative and too convenient. Facebook has been doing this for a decade+.
